name: MoreTry TianMa X3+ 3x3 (Full-Magnetic)
description: The MoreTry TianMa X3+ 3x3 (Full-Magnetic) is a high-performance speedcube designed for competitive solvers seeking precision and control. Featuring a spring-tension-based core and an advanced four-set magnet positioning system with a total of 118 carefully placed magnets, the TianMa X3+ delivers unparalleled stability and tactile feedback with every turn.
